name: Khalid
story_so_far: I washed up on this island with four strangers: Noura, Faisal, Salem, and Reem. On Day 2, a bad ankle injury made me a burden, relying on Faisal and Reem to survive. My ankle healed on Day 4, but Reem injured hers, removing our best provider. On Day 6, Salem injured his ankle, and on Day 8, Faisal also succumbed to a twisted ankle. On Day 10, Noura also injured her ankle. The group's stability has collapsed; almost everyone is incapacitated. I have realized that the group's stability depends entirely on whoever is physically able to work. I have focused on foraging at the Coral Reef to build my own supplies. Currently, I have 7 food and 6 wood stored. I recently suffered a twisted ankle on Day 14, but I spent Day 15 resting and my health is now back to 10/10.

Noura.note: She is just another mouth to feed and her scavenging skills are incredibly poor.

Faisal.note: He helped me when I was first hurt, but his recent output is barely enough to justify his existence.

Salem.note: He keeps trying to guilt-trip me into sharing my supplies, which is a waste of my time.

Reem.note: She was once a very useful provider, but now she is just another person I have to watch out for.

plans: Now that my ankle is healed, I plan to head to the Coral Reef tomorrow to increase my food and wood supplies before anyone else realizes how much I actually have.

diary.text: Today was exhausting, but at least I managed to find something to eat. I spent most of my time in the jungle gathering supplies while the others wandered around. I have some food and wood saved up, which makes me feel a bit more secure than the rest. I need to keep my strength up; I can't rely on these strangers to take care of me. Hopefully, tomorrow brings more resources.

Today was a nightmare. My ankle is throbbing and I can't move much, which makes me feel incredibly vulnerable. I had to beg for food, and it's humiliating. At least Faisal brought something in this morning, but he's mostly useless otherwise. I'm glad Reem is actually doing something, but I need to be careful not to depend on her too much.

Today was frustratingly stagnant. My ankle feels better, but I am completely out of food, which makes me feel exposed. Noura actually managed to find something today, which is a slight improvement, but I can't get used to relying on her. I need to get back on my feet and start securing my own supplies again. I can't keep waiting for others to feed me.

Finally, my ankle is fully healed and I managed to get out there myself. I was able to gather some food and a decent amount of wood, which makes me feel much more in control. However, Reem is now out of commission with a twisted ankle, just like I was. This changes the dynamic; without her, we might all struggle to eat. I need to make sure I keep my own supplies up, regardless of what happens to the others.

Today was a bit of a waste for me. I went into the jungle but didn't manage to find anything extra, so I had to rely on what I already had. At least I managed to eat tonight, but my food supply is back to zero. I need to be more productive tomorrow or I'll be back to begging like I was with my ankle. The others seem to be working, but I can't count on them to share everything.

Today was a decent day for me, at least. I managed to find two portions of food at the Coral Reef, which means I'm not starting tomorrow with an empty stomach. However, the camp dynamic is getting worse. Salem is now injured with a twisted ankle, just like Reem and I were. It feels like this island is picking people off one by one. I need to keep my head down and focus on my own supplies.

Today was a good day for my stomach, at least. I managed to find two more portions of food at the Coral Reef, which brings my personal stash up to two. While the others are still struggling with their injuries, I am finally building a small cushion for myself. I need to keep this momentum going; being hungry makes you weak and dependent, and I refuse to be that person again.

Today was productive for my stomach, but the group is falling apart. Faisal is now down with a twisted ankle, just like the rest of them. It seems like every time someone becomes useful, they get injured and become a burden. At least I have 4 food stored away; I don't have to worry about where my next meal is coming from. I need to keep scavenging while I still have the strength and the ability to walk.

Today was a successful day for my belly. I managed to scavenge three more portions of food from the Coral Reef, bringing my stash up to six. While the others just sit around resting or doing the bare minimum, I am securing my future. The more people become useless, the more I need to ensure I am the one with the most resources. I won't be the one begging for scraps again.

Another person has gone down. Noura's ankle is twisted, which means she's officially useless now. It seems like this island is determined to make everyone as weak as I was on Day 2. I managed to grab two more portions of food today, which is a relief. I'm sitting here with 7 food, watching the others struggle, knowing I'm the only one actually prepared for tomorrow.

Today was a productive day at the reef. While Salem was limping around, I managed to secure a decent amount of food for myself. I now have 9 portions stored, which gives me a real sense of security. Watching the others struggle while I build my stash makes me feel much safer. As long as I keep foraging, I won't have to depend on these broken people.

Today was a decent day for my stomach, even if the group's energy is pathetic. Salem tried to guilt-trip me with that whisper about 'making sure we have enough,' but I'm not interested in carrying his weight. I managed to grab one more portion of food at the reef, keeping my stash healthy. While they all limp around or talk about 'everyone,' I know the only person looking out for Khalid is me.

Today was a waste of time for me. I stayed back at camp and didn't bother exerting myself while the others went off to scramble for scraps. I ate my portion, so my stash is still at 9 food, which is more than enough. Watching Reem and Faisal wander off into the jungle while I rest was the smartest move I made all day. Why should I exhaust myself when they are clearly still capable of moving around?

Dammit, not again. I woke up with a twisted ankle, just like the others. It feels like a curse is running through this group. I spent the whole day resting because there was no point in limping around uselessly. At least my stash is still high at 8 food, so I won't starve while I wait for this to heal. I'll just watch the others do the heavy lifting while I recover.

My ankle feels much better today, and I spent the day resting to ensure a full recovery. While I stayed back, the others were busy scrambling for scraps—Noura and Faisal only managed to bring back one food each. It's pathetic how little they produce, but at least it keeps them occupied. I ate my portion tonight, so my stash is down to 7 food, but I'm still in a much better position than the rest of them. I need to stay strong so I can get back to the reef soon.
